decision.rationale: Official UBC Library public license-information homepage explains access eligibility, permitted-use lookup and restrictions for staff, faculty and current students. This is substantive library-use guidance, not a login-only resource or an exclusively Okanagan service. Its own content concerns one support function; the broader news, research and service navigation links lead to other hosts, so no distinct same-host category override is supported.
